<!--
STEP 2 OF 2 (cluster calling). Input: QC_Files/SeuratObjectFiltered_<SPECIES>_<sample>.rds from
scrnaseq_1_QC.Rmd.

HOW TO USE THIS FILE
Run interactively, chunk by chunk -- do not knit start-to-finish. Several chunks are DECISION
POINTS: they save diagnostic plots/tables, then you set a parameter (DIMS_FINAL, NN_FINAL,
MDIST_FINAL, RES_FINAL) by reading those outputs. Later chunks stop with a clear message until the
parameter is set. Values used for P. damicornis are given in comments as an example, not a default.
-->

# Setup

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(conflicted)
library(clustree)
library(cluster)       # silhouette
library(clusterCrit)   # Calinski-Harabasz, Davies-Bouldin
library(FNN)            # neighborhood preservation (get.knn)
library(patchwork)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::select, dplyr::filter, dplyr::count, dplyr::rename, dplyr::first,
  base::intersect, base::union, base::setdiff,
  purrr::map, purrr::discard,
  .quiet = TRUE
)

set.seed(1234)
```

# Configuration

```{r config}
SPECIES <- "<fill in: species code, same as in scrnaseq_1_QC.Rmd, e.g. Pdam>"

qc_rds_dir <- here("<fill in: QC output folder from step 1, e.g. output/Pdam/QC>", "QC_Files")
out_base   <- here("<fill in: output folder for clustering, e.g. output/Pdam/Seurat>")

# Sample IDs exactly as in step 1 (files are QC_Files/SeuratObjectFiltered_<SPECIES>_<sample_id>.rds)
sample_ids <- c("<fill in: sample ID 1>", "<fill in: sample ID 2>")
COVARIATE_NAME <- "genotype"   # what the covariate column from step 1 means (plot labels only)

N_VARIABLE_FEATURES <- 3000    # SCTransform / integration features (falls back to 2000 on memory errors)
```

```{r check-config}
stopifnot("Replace every '<fill in: ...>' value in the Configuration chunk first." =
            !any(grepl("<fill in", c(SPECIES, qc_rds_dir, out_base, sample_ids), fixed = TRUE)))

qc_out         <- file.path(out_base, "QC")
umap_sweep_dir <- file.path(qc_out, "UMAP_Sweep")
res_umap_dir   <- file.path(qc_out, "Resolution_UMAPs")
walk(c(out_base, qc_out, umap_sweep_dir, res_umap_dir), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sample_config <- tibble(
  sample_id = sample_ids,
  path      = file.path(qc_rds_dir, sprintf("SeuratObjectFiltered_%s_%s.rds", SPECIES, sample_ids))
)
stopifnot("QC-filtered .rds files not found -- run scrnaseq_1_QC.Rmd first and check paths." =
          all(file.exists(sample_config$path)))
sample_config
```

# Load QC-filtered objects

```{r load-objects}
sample.list <- map(sample_config$path, readRDS)
names(sample.list) <- sample_config$sample_id

map_int(sample.list, ncol)
```

# Per-sample SCTransform

```{r sctransform}
# Regress out percent_mito only if step 1 computed it (no mito genes for Pdam/Gfas -> nothing to regress).
sample.list <- map(sample.list, function(obj) {
  SCTransform(
    obj,
    method              = "glmGamPoi",
    variable.features.n = N_VARIABLE_FEATURES,
    vars.to.regress     = if ("percent_mito" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "percent_mito" else NULL,
    verbose             = FALSE
  )
})
```

```{r variable-feature-overlap}
var_feats <- map(sample.list, VariableFeatures)

pairwise_overlap <- combn(names(var_feats), 2, function(pair) {
  a <- var_feats[[pair[1]]]; b <- var_feats[[pair[2]]]
  tibble(
    sample_a = pair[1], sample_b = pair[2],
    n_shared = length(intersect(a, b)),
    jaccard  = length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
  )
}, simplify = FALSE) %>% bind_rows()

all_shared <- Reduce(intersect, var_feats)
message("Variable features shared across all samples: ", length(all_shared))

write_csv(pairwise_overlap, file.path(qc_out, "00b_VariableFeature_Overlap.csv"))
pairwise_overlap
```

# Integration

```{r integration}
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = sample.list, nfeatures = N_VARIABLE_FEATURES)
nfeatures_used <- N_VARIABLE_FEATURES

sample.list.prepped <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = sample.list, anchor.features = features)

anchors <- tryCatch({
  FindIntegrationAnchors(
    object.list          = sample.list.prepped,
    normalization.method = "SCT",
    anchor.features      = features,
    dims                 = 1:30,
    k.anchor             = 5
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  # Known Seurat v5 memory issue (protocol Section 3.2 / 6): retry at nfeatures = 2000.
  message("FindIntegrationAnchors failed at nfeatures=", N_VARIABLE_FEATURES, " (", conditionMessage(e),
          "). Retrying at nfeatures=2000 -- known Seurat v5 memory issue.")
  nfeatures_used <<- 2000
  features2 <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = sample.list, nfeatures = 2000)
  sample.list.prepped2 <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = sample.list, anchor.features = features2)
  FindIntegrationAnchors(
    object.list          = sample.list.prepped2,
    normalization.method = "SCT",
    anchor.features      = features2,
    dims                 = 1:30,
    k.anchor             = 5
  )
})

combined <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "integrated"

message("Integration complete. nfeatures used: ", nfeatures_used, " | cells: ", ncol(combined))
```

# PCA dimensionality — DECISION POINT

```{r pca}
combined <- RunPCA(combined, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(combined, ndims = 50) + ggtitle(paste(SPECIES, "— PCA elbow"))
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "01_ElbowPlot.jpeg"), p_elbow, width = 7, height = 5)

stdev <- combined[["pca"]]@stdev
pct_var <- (stdev^2) / sum(stdev^2) * 100
cum_var <- cumsum(pct_var)

pc_variance_table <- tibble(
  PC = seq_along(pct_var),
  pct_var = pct_var,
  cum_var = cum_var
)
algorithmic_elbow <- which.min(diff(pct_var))
pc_at_80 <- min(which(cum_var >= 80))
pc_at_85 <- min(which(cum_var >= 85))
pc_at_90 <- min(which(cum_var >= 90))

message("Algorithmic elbow (max drop in per-PC variance): PC ", algorithmic_elbow)
message("Cumulative variance crossings — 80%: PC ", pc_at_80,
        " | 85%: PC ", pc_at_85, " | 90%: PC ", pc_at_90)

write_csv(pc_variance_table, file.path(qc_out, "02_CumulativeVariance.csv"))

p_cumvar <- ggplot(pc_variance_table, aes(PC, cum_var)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(80, 85, 90), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = algorithmic_elbow, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  labs(y = "Cumulative % variance", title = paste(SPECIES, "— cumulative PCA variance")) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "02_CumulativeVariance.jpeg"), p_cumvar, width = 7, height = 5)

# PC gene-loading heatmaps in blocks of 9 -- confirm no early PC is dominated by a single gene
# family, and that PCs past your candidate cutoff aren't still biologically coherent.
pc_blocks <- split(1:50, ceiling(seq_along(1:50) / 9))
walk2(pc_blocks, seq_along(pc_blocks), function(dims_block, i) {
  jpeg(file.path(qc_out, sprintf("03_PCHeatmaps_block%02d.jpeg", i)),
       width = 1600, height = 1600, res = 150)
  DimHeatmap(combined, dims = dims_block, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE, fast = TRUE)
  dev.off()
})

pc_variance_table
```

```{r set-dims-final}
# ---- DECISION POINT ----
# Review 01_ElbowPlot.jpeg, 02_CumulativeVariance.jpeg/csv and the 03_PCHeatmaps_* blocks, then set
# DIMS_FINAL. Ignore the "algorithmic elbow" if it lands on PC1-2 (common with a steep PC1 drop).
# Pdam example: DIMS_FINAL = 30 (85% cumulative variance; PC heatmaps still coherent through ~PC36).
DIMS_FINAL <- NA   # <-- SET ME

stopifnot("Set DIMS_FINAL above before continuing." = !is.na(DIMS_FINAL))
```

# UMAP parameter sweep — DECISION POINT

```{r umap-sweep, eval = !is.na(DIMS_FINAL)}
nn_grid   <- c(20, 30, 50)
mdist_grid <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)
grid <- expand_grid(nn = nn_grid, mdist = mdist_grid)

DefaultAssay(combined) <- "integrated"

max_cells_metrics <- min(3000, ncol(combined))
metric_cells <- sample(colnames(combined), max_cells_metrics)

pca_emb <- Embeddings(combined, "pca")[metric_cells, 1:DIMS_FINAL]

sweep_results <- pmap(grid, function(nn, mdist) {
  combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:DIMS_FINAL, n.neighbors = nn, min.dist = mdist,
                       verbose = FALSE)
  umap_emb <- Embeddings(combined, "umap")[metric_cells, ]

  # Neighborhood preservation: fraction of true k-NN (PCA space) recovered in UMAP space.
  k <- 30
  knn_pca  <- get.knn(pca_emb,  k = k)$nn.index
  knn_umap <- get.knn(umap_emb, k = k)$nn.index
  preservation <- mean(map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(knn_pca)), function(i) {
    length(intersect(knn_pca[i, ], knn_umap[i, ])) / k
  }))

  # Cluster quality at a fixed placeholder resolution (0.5) -- cross-grid comparison only, NOT the
  # final resolution decision (that's Section 3.5 below).
  combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, dims = 1:DIMS_FINAL, verbose = FALSE)
  combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
  clust_sub <- combined$seurat_clusters[metric_cells]

  crit <- intCriteria(pca_emb, as.integer(clust_sub), c("Calinski_Harabasz", "Davies_Bouldin"))
  sil <- silhouette(as.integer(clust_sub), dist(pca_emb))
  avg_sil <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])

  # Covariate mixing entropy per cluster, normalized to [0,1] (1 = perfectly mixed).
  covar_sub <- combined$covariate[metric_cells]
  n_cat <- length(unique(covar_sub))
  entropy_by_cluster <- tapply(covar_sub, clust_sub, function(x) {
    p <- table(x) / length(x)
    -sum(p * log(p)) / log(n_cat)
  })
  mean_entropy <- mean(entropy_by_cluster, na.rm = TRUE)

  p_umap <- DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("nn=%d, min.dist=%.1f", nn, mdist)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(
    metrics = tibble(
      n_neighbors = nn, min_dist = mdist,
      neighborhood_preservation = preservation,
      calinski_harabasz = crit$calinski_harabasz,
      davies_bouldin = crit$davies_bouldin,
      avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
      mean_covariate_entropy = mean_entropy
    ),
    plot = p_umap
  )
})

umap_sweep_metrics <- bind_rows(map(sweep_results, "metrics"))
write_csv(umap_sweep_metrics, file.path(umap_sweep_dir, "umap_sweep_metrics.csv"))

p_grid <- wrap_plots(map(sweep_results, "plot"), ncol = 3)
ggsave(file.path(umap_sweep_dir, "umap_sweep_grid.jpeg"), p_grid, width = 15, height = 15)

umap_sweep_metrics
```

```{r set-umap-final}
# ---- DECISION POINT ----
# Review umap_sweep_metrics.csv and umap_sweep_grid.jpeg. Prioritize neighborhood_preservation when
# metrics disagree, then prefer clean, round (not smeared) clusters. n.neighbors / min.dist only change
# the 2D layout -- clusters come from the PCA graph -- so this is a visualization choice. With few
# samples, don't over-weight mean covariate entropy.
# Pdam example: NN_FINAL = 30, MDIST_FINAL = 0.3.
NN_FINAL    <- NA   # <-- SET ME
MDIST_FINAL <- NA   # <-- SET ME

stopifnot("Set NN_FINAL and MDIST_FINAL above before continuing." =
            !is.na(NN_FINAL) && !is.na(MDIST_FINAL))

combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:DIMS_FINAL, n.neighbors = NN_FINAL, min.dist = MDIST_FINAL,
                     verbose = FALSE)
```

# Clustering resolution sweep — DECISION POINT

```{r resolution-sweep, eval = !is.na(NN_FINAL)}
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, dims = 1:DIMS_FINAL, verbose = FALSE)

res_seq <- seq(0.2, 1.0, by = 0.1)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = res_seq, verbose = FALSE)

res_cols <- grep("^integrated_snn_res\\.", colnames(combined@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# 1. Cluster count vs. resolution
cluster_counts <- tibble(
  resolution = res_seq,
  n_clusters = map_dbl(res_cols, ~ length(unique(combined@meta.data[[.x]])))
)
write_csv(cluster_counts, file.path(qc_out, "cluster_count_vs_resolution.csv"))

p_counts <- ggplot(cluster_counts, aes(resolution, n_clusters)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = paste(SPECIES, "— cluster count vs. resolution")) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "05_ClusterCount_vs_Resolution.jpeg"), p_counts, width = 7, height = 5)

# 2. Clustree
p_clustree <- clustree(combined, prefix = "integrated_snn_res.")
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "06_Clustree.jpeg"), p_clustree, width = 10, height = 10)

# 3. Silhouette width vs. resolution (subsampled, PCA-space distances)
pca_emb_full <- Embeddings(combined, "pca")[metric_cells, 1:DIMS_FINAL]
dist_full <- dist(pca_emb_full)

silhouette_by_res <- map_dbl(res_cols, function(col) {
  clust_sub <- combined@meta.data[metric_cells, col]
  if (length(unique(clust_sub)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  mean(silhouette(as.integer(as.character(clust_sub)) + 1L, dist_full)[, "sil_width"])
})
silhouette_table <- tibble(resolution = res_seq, avg_silhouette = silhouette_by_res)
write_csv(silhouette_table, file.path(qc_out, "silhouette_vs_resolution.csv"))

p_sil <- ggplot(silhouette_table, aes(resolution, avg_silhouette)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = paste(SPECIES, "— silhouette width vs. resolution")) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "07_Silhouette_vs_Resolution.jpeg"), p_sil, width = 7, height = 5)

# Per-resolution UMAP panels for visual/biological-interpretability review
walk(res_cols, function(col) {
  res_label <- sub("integrated_snn_res\\.", "", col)
  p <- DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = col, label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Resolution ", res_label))
  ggsave(file.path(res_umap_dir, sprintf("resolution_%s.jpeg", res_label)),
         p, width = 7, height = 6)
})

cluster_counts
```

```{r set-res-final}
# ---- DECISION POINT ----
# Review the plateau in 05_ClusterCount_vs_Resolution.jpeg, stable ("quiet") levels in 06_Clustree.jpeg,
# the peak/plateau in 07_Silhouette_vs_Resolution.jpeg, and whether clusters in Resolution_UMAPs/ look
# biologically sensible. Resolutions tested: 0.2-1.0 in steps of 0.1.
# Pdam example: RES_FINAL = 0.5 (26 clusters).
RES_FINAL <- NA   # <-- SET ME

stopifnot("Set RES_FINAL above before continuing." = !is.na(RES_FINAL))

res_col_values <- as.numeric(sub("integrated_snn_res\\.", "", res_cols))
match_idx <- which(abs(res_col_values - RES_FINAL) < 1e-6)
stopifnot("RES_FINAL does not match any resolution column that was actually computed above." =
            length(match_idx) == 1)
final_res_col <- res_cols[match_idx]

combined$seurat_clusters <- combined@meta.data[[final_res_col]]
Idents(combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

message("Final clustering: ", length(unique(combined$seurat_clusters)), " clusters at resolution ",
        RES_FINAL)
```

# Cluster QC diagnostics

```{r cluster-qc, eval = !is.na(RES_FINAL)}
# Cell counts per cluster per covariate level -- flag <50 cells or >90% from one level.
cluster_covariate_counts <- combined@meta.data %>%
  count(seurat_clusters, covariate) %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), pct = n / total) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_flags <- cluster_covariate_counts %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = first(total),
    max_covariate_pct = max(pct),
    flag_low_n = total_cells < 50,
    flag_covariate_skew = max_covariate_pct > 0.90,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write_csv(cluster_flags, file.path(qc_out, "cluster_qc_flags.csv"))
write_csv(cluster_covariate_counts, file.path(qc_out, "cluster_covariate_counts.csv"))

if (any(cluster_flags$flag_low_n | cluster_flags$flag_covariate_skew)) {
  message("Clusters flagged for review before Stage B annotation:")
  print(filter(cluster_flags, flag_low_n | flag_covariate_skew))
}

qc_feats <- intersect(c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "log10GenesPerUMI", "percent_mito"), colnames(combined@meta.data))
p_qc_violin <- VlnPlot(combined, features = qc_feats, group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0, ncol = 1)
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "cluster_qc_violins.jpeg"), p_qc_violin, width = 10, height = 8)

# Covariate mixing -- stacked bar + split UMAP
p_stack <- ggplot(cluster_covariate_counts, aes(seurat_clusters, pct, fill = covariate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = paste(COVARIATE_NAME, "composition per cluster"), y = "Proportion", fill = COVARIATE_NAME) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "cluster_covariate_stackedbar.jpeg"), p_stack, width = 8, height = 5)

p_split <- DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", split.by = "covariate", label = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(qc_out, "umap_split_by_covariate.jpeg"), p_split, width = 6 * length(unique(combined$covariate)), height = 6)

cluster_flags
```

# Save finalized parameters and pre-annotation object

```{r save-outputs, eval = !is.na(RES_FINAL)}
finalised_params <- tibble(
  n_samples = nrow(sample_config),
  species = SPECIES,
  n_cells = ncol(combined),
  nfeatures_used = nfeatures_used,
  dims_final = DIMS_FINAL,
  nn_final = NN_FINAL,
  mdist_final = MDIST_FINAL,
  res_final = RES_FINAL,
  n_clusters_final = length(unique(combined$seurat_clusters)),
  date = as.character(Sys.Date())
)
write_csv(finalised_params, file.path(qc_out, "00_Finalised_Parameters.csv"))

saveRDS(combined, file.path(out_base, sprintf("%s_integrated.rds", SPECIES)))

finalised_params
```
